release_metadata.title: BioTasks notebook pilot: MDAnalysis structural comparison
release_metadata.description: One task grounded in the complete original MDAnalysis RMSD tutorial, with exact original simulation-input notices and separate scientific/native validation evidence.
release_metadata.methodology: Convert the original pinned notebook to a script; GLM-5.3 with native high requested selects terminal exports, prepares the frozen offline environment, specifies and constructs the task. Independently authored controls, original-source coverage review and native Harbor oracle/no-op controls validate the task; a blind GLM attempt is recorded. Release requires source-bound evidence of seven completed autonomous stages and zero operator interventions. Effective served effort and cross-engine portability are not established.
